theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+0.48%) and Consumer Discretionary (+0.30%) led the market today, while Financials (-0.41%) and Industrials (-0.37%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.26%, defensives -0.12%, and value/cyclicals -0.20% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +1.30% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.28%. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.10%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 3.56% to 15.42, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.04% to $4,389.50, crude oil was little changed at $79.74, and bitcoin gained 0.02% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
